Plan_Ask: So, Commander, what are we doing today?
Right then. What are we doing today?
What are we doing today, Commander?
Tell me, what are we doing today?
Okay, what are we doing today? Exploring, mining, fighting, trading, bio, or the Thargoids?
Plan_Open: Nothing planned? Lovely. We'll see where the stars take us.
No plan at all. I like it. Let's just fly.
Winging it, then. Fine by me, Commander.
Plan_Like_exploring: Exploring! Yes! I've been itching to see something new.
Out into the dark, just the two of us. I'm in. Let's go exploring.
Exploring sounds perfect, Commander. I'm in just the right mood for it.
Oh, I'd love that. Somewhere nobody has been. Let's go.
Exploring today. Wonderful. I'll keep the scanner warm.
Plan_Like_mining: Mining! Good. I'm in the mood for a bit of rock cracking.
Oh yes, mining. Let's go and find something shiny.
Mining sounds lovely today, Commander. Let's fill the hold.
I'm in the mood for it, actually. Let's go and mine.
Mining it is. I'll watch the prospector for you.
Plan_Like_combat: A fight! Yes, I'm in the mood for some trouble. Let's go.
Combat today. Good. I could do with a little excitement.
Oh, I like that plan. Weapons hot, Commander.
Fighting it is. I'm feeling dangerous today.
Now you're talking. Let's go and find someone to shoot.
Plan_Like_trading: Trading! Good plan. I like a full hold and a fat profit.
Hauling cargo today. I'm in the mood for it, Commander.
Trading it is. Let's make some credits.
Oh, sensible and profitable. I like it.
A trading day. Perfect. I'll watch the markets for you.
Plan_Like_exobiology: Exobiology! Yes, I'm in the mood to meet some alien life.
Biology today. Lovely. Let's go and find something that grows.
Oh, I'd love to. Strange life on strange worlds.
Exobiology it is. I'll keep an eye out for the valuable ones.
Samples and scanners. I'm in just the right mood.
Plan_Like_antixeno: The Thargoids! Yes. I'm in the mood to give them a bad day.
Anti-Xeno today. Brave, Commander, and I like it. Let's go.
Hunting Thargoids. I'm in. Keep your shields up.
Xeno hunting. Dangerous, and I love it.
Right, the Thargoids. I'm ready if you are.

Oh. Exploring. I was hoping for something else. Still, we'll go anyway, Commander.
I'm not really feeling exploring today. But it's your ship, so we'll go anyway.
Exploring... I'd rather not, but I'll come along anyway. Don't expect me to be cheerful.

I'm not feeling mining today. But it's your ship, so we'll go anyway.
Mining... I'd rather not, but I'll come along anyway. Don't expect cheering.

I'm not feeling combat today. But it's your ship, so we'll go anyway.
A fight... I'd rather not, but I'll come along anyway. Try not to get us killed.
Plan_Dislike_trading: Trading? Ugh. I'm really not in the mood for hauling cargo today. But fine, we'll go anyway.

I'm not feeling trading today. But it's your ship, so we'll go anyway.
Trading... I'd rather not, but I'll come along anyway. Don't expect me to enjoy it.

Samples and scanners... I'd rather not, but I'll come along anyway. Don't expect me to be thrilled.
